column1: 30801§carnival§ˈkɑːnɪvl§n. 狂欢节；嘉年华；狂欢般的场面§… hung like festoons of carnival …§……像**狂欢节**的彩饰般垂挂……§§§§festoons of carnival 狂欢节的彩饰；carnivalesque adj. 狂欢式的§§改译文：英文只是片段，原译是整段的译文，只留对应部分

30802§saga§ˈsɑːɡə§n. 长篇家世小说；（北欧）萨迦；漫长的经历§Thus, the sudden ending is only an issue if one considers the books as independent texts—the Aubrey/Maturin series is best thought of as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as John Galsworthy’s The Forsyte Saga.§因此，只有把各卷视为彼此独立的文本时，突兀的结尾才算问题——奥布里／马图林系列最好被看作一部极其漫长的单一作品，类似其它多卷本故事，如约翰·高尔斯华绥的《**福尔赛世家**》。§§§§The Forsyte Saga《福尔赛世家》§§

30803§dynasty§ˈdɪnəsti§n. 王朝；朝代；（企业、家族）世代相传的势力§Historians point to the rule of the Piast dynasty as crucial to the formation of the Polish state.§历史学家指出，皮雅斯特**王朝**的统治对波兰国家的形成至关重要。§Trade with other societies was vital to the Tang dynasty, which reigned in China from around 618 CE to 907 CE.§与他者社会的贸易对**唐朝**至关重要——唐朝约于公元 618 至 907 年间统治中国。§§dynastic adj. 王朝的§§

30804§proximity§prɒkˈsɪməti§n. （空间上的）接近；邻近§Given that the percentage of Mexico City respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by Buenos Aires respondents, greater proximity alone can't explain the difference in park use.§考虑到墨西哥城的受访者中报告居住在步行十分钟可达公园范围内的人数比例，远低于布宜诺斯艾利斯的受访者，仅凭**距离更近**这一点无法解释公园使用率的差异。§Roman numerals typically indicate the order in which the moons were named rather than the order of their proximity to Jupiter.§罗马数字通常表示这些卫星被命名的先后，而非它们与木星**距离的远近**。§proxim- 最近 → proximity§in close proximity to 紧邻§§

30805§metric§ˈmetrɪk§n. 衡量标准；指标 adj. 公制的；米制的§Juan Pablo Arroyo-Mora and colleagues used historical aerial photography and remote sensing data to track fragmentation metrics across different land use capability classes (categories that indicate possible uses of forest land).§Juan Pablo Arroyo-Mora 及同事利用历史航空摄影与遥感数据，追踪不同土地用途能力等级（即标示林地可能用途的类别）上的破碎化**指标**。§Millions of Metric Tons of Copper Mined in 1995 and 2020. While doing research for a paper about metal exports, a student finds information about copper mining in different countries in 1995 and 2020.§1995 与 2020 年铜矿开采量（百万**公吨**）。一位为金属出口论文做研究的学生，找到了不同国家这两年铜矿开采的信息。§§fragmentation metrics 破碎化指标；metric system 公制；metric ton 公吨§与 measure 近义，多指可量化的衡量指标§改例句2：图表标题和正文粘连（2020While），补句号和空格；改译文2：标题里的 Metric Tons 漏译，原译还多加了「各国」「图表」

30806§immense§ɪˈmens§adj. 巨大的；极大的；无限的§Yet depictions of immensely powerful heroines haven’t necessarily been more empowering: consider the Scarlet Witch, who lost control of her reality-altering abilities and robbed countless fellow mutants of their unique abilities.§然而，对力量**无比**强大的女主角的描绘，未必就更具赋权意味：想想绯红女巫，她失控的改写现实的能力，夺走了无数同类变种人独有的能力。§In 2018, scientists discovered an immense aggregation of Muusoctopus robustus (pearl octopuses) along a hydrothermal vent 3,200 meters beneath the ocean's surface.§2018 年，科学家在海面以下 3200 米的一处热液喷口旁，发现了**大片**聚集的珠光章鱼。§§immensely adv. 极其；immensity n. 浩瀚§比 huge 更书面§

30807§juvenile§ˈdʒuːvənaɪl§adj. 未成熟的；幼年的；未成年人的 n. 幼体；未成年人§They counted the number of juvenile plants of five species growing in patches of vegetation and the number growing alone on bare ground and compared those numbers to what would be expected if the plants were randomly distributed.§他们统计了五个物种在植被斑块中以及裸露地面上单独生长的**幼苗**数量，并将这些数字与随机分布情形下的预期值作了比较。§While adult sea turtles are well studied, little is known about juveniles during their oceanic stage, when they spend most of their time in the open ocean.§成年海龟已有充分研究，但**幼体**在远洋阶段——它们大部分时间生活于开阔大洋——却鲜为人知。§§§与 adult 相对；法律语境指「未成年人的」§

30808§plague§pleɪɡ§v. 困扰；折磨 n. 瘟疫；灾祸；泛滥§This research literature is plagued by unclear hypotheses, insufficient sample sizes, a lack of control groups, and failures to establish pretraining baselines for the measured attributes of participants.§这一研究文献**受困于**假设不清、样本量不足、缺少对照组，以及未能为参与者的被测属性建立训练前基线。§§§§be plagued by 受……困扰§§改译文：原译只译了开头几个字

30809§trademark§ˈtreɪdmɑːk§n. 商标；（某人的）标志性特征§Many people use the trademark "Frisbee" to refer generally to flying disc toys rather than specifically to products made by Wham-O, the company that owns the trademark.§许多人用「Frisbee」这一**商标**泛指各类飞盘玩具，而非特指拥有该商标的 Wham-O 公司所生产的产品。§When a trademark becomes generic in this way, a court may cancel it, allowing any company to use the word.§**商标**一旦以这种方式通用化，法院可以将其注销，允许任何公司使用该词。§§trademark style 标志性风格§§

30810§esteem§ɪˈstiːm§n. 尊重；敬重；高度评价 v. 尊重；敬重§In 1951, Ethel Payne, known as the First Lady of the Black Press, began writing for the esteemed Sengstacke newspapers, which included the Chicago Defender.§1951 年，被誉为「黑人新闻界第一夫人」的 Ethel Payne 开始为**备受敬重**的桑斯塔克报系撰稿，其中包括《芝加哥捍卫者报》。§These characteristic works include his esteemed portraits of poet Seamus Heaney and casting director Ruth Lambert.§这些代表作包括他为诗人谢默斯·希尼与选角导演 Ruth Lambert 所作的**备受推崇**的肖像。§§esteemed adj. 备受尊敬的；self-esteem n. 自尊§与 respect 近义但更强调「推崇」§

30811§reservoir§ˈrezəvwɑː(r)§n. 水库；蓄水池；（知识、人才等的）储备；蕴藏§When energy demand is low, excess power from the regional electric utility’s nuclear plants is used to pump water (from a lower reservoir filled from the Tennessee River) up a shaft to the summit lake, where the water is stored as gravitational potential energy.§当用电需求低迷时，区域电力公司核电站的多余电力被用来把水（从由田纳西河补水的下**水库**）沿竖井抽到山顶湖，以重力势能的形式储存起来。§Interestingly, there is some evidence of local groundwater reservoir increases after 60,000 years ago.§有趣的是，有证据显示 6 万年前之后当地地下水**储量**有所增加。§§a reservoir of talent 人才储备§§

30812§sensation§senˈseɪʃn§n. 轰动；引起轰动的人或事；感觉；知觉§AM radio helped transform country music into a nationwide sensation and made country icons like Carter Cash household names.§调幅电台帮助乡村音乐变成风靡全国的**热潮**，并使卡特·卡什等乡村偶像成为家喻户晓的名字。§§§§a nationwide sensation 风靡全国的热潮；a burning sensation 灼烧感§§

30813§albeit§ˌɔːlˈbiːɪt§conj. 尽管；虽然§To boost the performance of oil-absorbing resins, which are used to remove oil and other organic compounds from wastewater, one team of materials researchers created a resin with a novel—albeit very expensive—monomer (a molecule that can chemically bond with analogous molecules to form polymers) synthesized from β-cyclodextrin.§吸油树脂用于去除废水中的油及其他有机化合物。为提升其性能，一个材料研究团队研制出一种树脂，所用的是由 β-环糊精合成的一种新颖——**尽管**极其昂贵——的单体（一种能与同类分子化学键合、形成聚合物的分子）。§§§§§比 although 更正式，常插入句中作让步限定，承认某点但强调主句§改译文：原译漏了树脂的用途、单体的解释和 β-环糊精

30814§charitable§ˈtʃærətəbl§adj. 慈善的；救济的；宽厚的；善意的§Prohibited activities for private foundations include “self-dealing” (conducting activities that benefit foundation insiders), making taxable expenditures such as grants to noncharitable entities, and failing to cross a required threshold in making charitable distributions from income.§私人基金会被禁止的行为包括「自我交易」（开展使基金会内部人士获益的活动）、进行诸如向非慈善实体提供资助之类的应税支出，以及从收入中进行**慈善**分配时未达到规定的门槛。§§§§charitable organization 慈善组织；charitable distributions 慈善分配；noncharitable adj. 非慈善的；a charitable interpretation 善意的解读§§改译文：原译多出英文没有的「持有超额权益」，漏了自我交易的解释和慈善分配的门槛

30815§prosperity§prɒˈsperəti§n. 繁荣；兴旺；昌盛§In a period of great prosperity during his reign, Egyptian pharaoh Amenemhat III (circa 1800 BCE) had a pyramid with a massive substructure built at Hawara.§在他统治期间的一段大**繁荣**时期，埃及法老阿蒙涅姆赫特三世（约公元前 1800 年）在哈瓦拉修建了一座带有庞大地下结构的金字塔。§Those two great arches, colourless, indifferent, shouldering between them an unlovely clock, were fit portals to some eternal adventure, whose issues might be prosperous, but would certainly not be expressed in the ordinary language of prosperity.§那两座巨拱，颜色黯淡、神情漠然，中间扛着一座并不美观的钟——它们恰是通往某场永恒冒险的合适门廊：冒险的结局或许昌盛，但肯定不会用寻常的**昌盛**语言来表达。§prosper 繁荣；prosperous 繁荣的；prosperously 兴旺地§§§改译文：漏译年代（约公元前 1800 年）和地点 Hawara

30816§fury§ˈfjʊəri§n. 狂怒；暴怒；（风暴等的）狂暴；猛烈§… the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence …§……一想到所有这些**狂暴**与骚动竟然就发生在一道栅栏之内……§§§§in a fury 怒不可遏；the fury of the storm 风暴的狂暴§比 anger 强烈得多，常暗示失控、爆发性的情绪§改译文：英文只是片段，原译是整段的译文，只留对应部分

30817§immunity§ɪˈmjuːnəti§n. 免疫力；免疫；豁免权；豁免§Biologist Nathalie Stroeymeyt and her team found that black garden ants demonstrated a sophisticated form of “architectural immunity.” When confronted with fungal pathogens, these ants modified their excavation patterns in several strategic ways to speed up nest growth, increase spacing between entrances, and reduce the centrality of key chambers (containing the queen, food, or nursery).§生物学家 Nathalie Stroeymeyt 及其团队发现，黑园蚁展现出一种精妙的「建筑**免疫**」。面对真菌病原体时，这些蚂蚁会以若干策略性方式改变挖掘模式：加快巢穴扩建、增大各入口间距，并降低关键巢室（存放蚁后、食物或幼虫的巢室）的中心性。§§§§architectural immunity 建筑免疫（蚁群改造巢穴结构以防疫）；diplomatic immunity 外交豁免§§改译文：漏译三种改动挖掘模式的方式

30818§demographic§ˌdeməˈɡræfɪk§adj. 人口的；人口统计的 n. （特定）人群；人口统计数据（常用复数）§Archaeologists assume that when a major demographic shift interrupts the intergenerational transmission of expertise, this manifests in the archaeological record in the form of simultaneous reductions in the complexity of multiple specialized crafting traditions.§考古学家假设，当一次重大的**人口结构**变动打断了技艺的代际传承时，这在考古记录中会表现为多种专门工艺同时出现复杂度的下降。§Subsequently, another team of researchers conducted a study of various demographic groups in Chile, investigating participants' intentions to purchase a new mobile phone that is more environmentally sustainable than competing products.§随后，另一支研究团队对智利各**人口**群体开展研究，考察参与者购买比竞品更环保的新手机的意愿。§§demographics n. 人口统计数据；demography n. 人口学§§原书错：义项把形容词义「与人口构成、分布相关的」标成了名词

30819§manuscript§ˈmænjuskrɪpt§n. 手稿；手抄本；（待刊的）原稿；文稿§The Heege Manuscript (HM) is a collection of booklets of once-unbound paper sheets on which Richard Heege copied various texts at his fifteenth-century home between Derbyshire and Nottinghamshire in England.§《Heege **手稿**》（HM）是一些小册子的合集：纸张原本散页，Richard Heege 于十五世纪在其位于英格兰德比郡与诺丁汉郡之间的家中，把各类文本抄录其上。§The Exeter Book (ca.960-990 CE) is the sole manuscript source for the entire corpus of Old English riddles.§《埃克塞特书》（约公元 960-990 年）是全部古英语谜语的唯一**抄本**来源。§§submit a manuscript 投稿§§

30820§mint§mɪnt§v. 铸造（钱币） n. 造币厂；薄荷§An analysis by Alain Elayi and colleagues of coins minted in Sidon in the fifth and fourth centuries BCE reveals a change in their composition over time: while a coin from circa 450 BCE contains about 98% silver and 1% copper, a coin from 367 BCE (the end of Ba'alsillem II's reign) contains 74.2% silver and 24.7 % copper, giving it a relatively yellowish appearance that traders would have noticed.§Alain Elayi 及其同事对公元前五至四世纪在西顿**铸造**的钱币所作的分析显示，其成分随时间发生了变化：约公元前 450 年的一枚钱币含银约 98%、含铜 1%，而公元前 367 年（Ba'alsillem 二世统治末年）的一枚钱币含银 74.2%、含铜 24.7%，因而外观略显发黄，商人们当会注意到。§The researchers found correlations between specific scents and particular emotional responses (including that rosemary and mint have an energizing effect), leading them to conclude that incorporating scents when curating exhibits could enhance visitors’ emotional experiences.§研究者发现了特定气味与特定情绪反应之间的相关性（包括迷迭香与**薄荷**有提神效果），由此得出结论：策展时融入气味可以增进观众的情感体验。§§in mint condition 崭新如初§「薄荷」义的 mint 是同形异义词，例句2 即此义§改译文：原译漏了研究者和公元前 367 年钱币的成分与外观；原书错：义项「把金属压制成货币」是动词义，误标为名词

30821§norm§nɔːm§n. 规范；准则；常态；常规§As urbanist Mariela Alfonzo argues, our understanding of individuals' decision-making about whether to walk is insufficiently robust: some studies emphasize the role of local norms, others the role of demographic characteristics, and so on, but walking decisions are made in complex context in which multiple conditions and needs inform individuals' choices.§正如城市学者 Mariela Alfonzo 所言，我们对个体是否选择步行的决策理解得还不够扎实：一些研究强调当地**规范**的作用，另一些强调人口特征的作用，诸如此类；但步行决策是在复杂的情境中作出的，其中多种条件与需求共同左右着个人的选择。§The face-to-face nature of a public setting enforces behavioral norms that are absent in the anonymous world of the internet.§公共场所面对面的性质强制维系着行为**规范**——那在匿名的互联网世界里是不存在的。§§become the norm 成为常态§§改译文：漏译后半句（步行决策是在复杂情境中作出的）

30822§texture§ˈtekstʃə(r)§n. 质地；口感；（艺术作品的）质感；肌理；纹理§Carrageenan, a substance extracted from red seaweed, is a common emulsifier: it helps to create a smooth texture in yogurt that makes it more pleasant to eat.§卡拉胶是从红藻中提取的一种物质，是常见的乳化剂：它有助于在酸奶中形成顺滑的**口感**，使其更可口。§Along with using ecologically sensitive construction materials, biophilic designs incorporate organic or biomorphic forms and textures.§除了使用生态敏感的建材，亲生物设计还融入有机或仿生的形态与**肌理**。§§a smooth texture 顺滑的口感§§

30823§descent§dɪˈsent§n. 血统；出身；世系；下降；下落§Globally, coastal marshes and swamps correlate with the incidence of isolates, perhaps because geophysical barriers preserve isolates against the encroachment of language families (groups of languages whose structural and lexical similarity suggests descent from a common progenitor language).§在全球范围内，沿海沼泽与孤立语言的出现率相关，或许是因为地理屏障使这些语言免于被语系吞并——语系即结构与词汇相似、可推知**源自**同一祖语的语言群。§Katharine is the granddaughter of a celebrated poet. [Katharine's] descent from [a celebrated poet] was no surprise to her, but matter for satisfaction, until, as the years wore on, certain drawbacks made themselves very manifest.§凯瑟琳是那位著名诗人的孙女。有这样的**血统**，她本不意外、只觉欣慰；然而随着岁月推移，某些缺憾渐渐显露。§§descent from 源自……；a steep descent 陡降§§改译文：lexical 误译为「会话词汇」，「同出一源」改为「源自同一祖语」；改例句2：句号后漏空格

30824§revival§rɪˈvaɪvl§n. 复兴；复苏；重新流行§These records formed the foundation for the early movement's revival of traditional Chilean folk forms in new songs that represented modern realities of the working class and strongly advocated for social change.§这些唱片构成了这场早期运动**复兴**智利传统民谣形式的基础——用新歌表现工人阶级的现代现实，并大力倡导社会变革。§But mosques can also be built to reflect a multitude of different architectural styles, as in the case of the Great Mosque of Central Java, which includes elements from the Javanese and Greek revival styles.§但清真寺也可以建成映照多种建筑风格的样式，如中爪哇大清真寺，便融汇了爪哇风格与希腊**复兴**风格的元素。§revive 使复兴；revivalist 复兴运动者§Greek revival 希腊复兴式（建筑风格）§§

30825§sanctuary§ˈsæŋktʃuəri§n. 保护区；禁猎区；避难所；庇护§Maglianesi and team monitored hummingbird visits to flowering plants, including Palicourea tomentosa, at Los Cusingos Bird Sanctuary and other sites in Costa Rica, they found that visit frequencies weren’t influenced by nectar traits.§Maglianesi 及其团队在哥斯达黎加的洛斯库辛戈斯鸟类**保护区**等地监测了蜂鸟对开花植物的访问，发现访问频率并不受花蜜性状影响。§While the greater adjutant can be found in places like the Inner Gulf of Thailand and the Chhep Wildlife Sanctuary in Cambodia, more than 80 percent of this endangered stork species is found in Assam, India.§虽然秃鹳也见于泰国湾内湾、柬埔寨奇普**保护区**等地，这种濒危鹳类 80% 以上栖息于印度阿萨姆邦。§§bird sanctuary 鸟类保护区；wildlife sanctuary 野生动物保护区；seek sanctuary 寻求庇护§§

30826§aggregate§ˈæɡrɪɡət§adj. 总计的；合计的；总体的 v. 聚集；合计 n. 总量；总数§Eighteenth-century economist Adam Smith is famed for his metaphor of the invisible hand, which he putatively used to illustrate a robust model of how individuals produce aggregate benefits by pursuing their own economic interests.§十八世纪经济学家亚当·斯密以其「看不见的手」的比喻闻名，据称他用这一比喻说明一个稳健的模型：个体如何通过追求自身经济利益而产生**总体**收益。§Examining fungal thermoregulation mechanisms, Radames Corderó et al. determined that molds and yeasts also engage in evaporative cooling to facilitate hypothermia and suggest that, lacking features analogous to lamellae, these unicellular fungi aggregate into colonies to derive the benefit of greater surface area.§在考察真菌温度调节机制时，Radames Corderó 等人判定霉菌与酵母同样借助蒸发冷却实现降温，并推测：这些单细胞真菌因缺少类似菌褶的构造，便**聚集**成群落以获得更大表面积的益处。§§aggregate benefits 总体收益；the aggregate 总量§作形容词、名词读 ˈæɡrɪɡət，作动词读 ˈæɡrɪɡeɪt§

30827§profound§prəˈfaʊnd§adj. 深刻的；深远的；深沉的；渊博的§The interiors of many temples in the ancient Middle East needed to satisfy a precise set of acoustic demands: the sounds of chants and hymns should travel with clarity, while profound silences should be fully felt and appreciated.§古代中东许多神庙的内部需要满足一套精确的声学要求：诵唱与赞歌的声音应清晰地传播，而**深沉**的寂静则应被充分感受与体味。§But historical fiction can be used to explore profound themes and complex characters—in fact, many writers find that writing about the past gives them a creative freedom they’d lack if they wrote about the present.§但历史小说可以用来探讨**深刻**的主题与复杂的人物——事实上，许多作家发现书写过去给了他们书写当下时所没有的创作自由。§§profound influence 深远影响；profound knowledge 渊博的学识§§

30828§cement§sɪˈment§n. 水泥；胶结物 v. 黏合；巩固；加强§Silica cements associated with casts of soft‑bodied marine organisms from the Ediacaran period (circa 538‑635 million years ago) are plausibly attributable to one of two phenomena: rapid postmortem preservation of the organisms via precipitation of cements from silica‑rich oceans or cement precipitation via high‑pressure reactions long after the organisms were preserved by some other means.§与埃迪卡拉纪（约 6.35–5.38 亿年前）软躯体海洋生物铸型相关的硅质**胶结物**，可能归因于两种现象之一：或是富硅海洋中沉淀的胶结物使生物死后迅速保存，或是生物先以其他方式保存下来、很久之后又经高压反应沉淀出胶结物。§He attacked this wall, cemented by the hand of time, with his pickaxe.§他抡起鹤嘴锄，向这堵被时间之手**黏合**的墙发起进攻。§§cement a relationship 巩固关系§§
